title: Touring with Celestin and stopping to raise children
summary: She traveled through the South with the big band while her husband played in it, then stopped touring after her children were born.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Yes. Did you travel out of town much with Celesteiner?
I traveled quite a bit with him, with the big band.
I didn't mind it then because I had a husband in the band. So it didn't matter too much traveling then, I was in the 30s. We went all over the south.
And how old was your oldest child? When was the oldest child?
So this is 60, huh? So could you travel after your child was born?

I traveled a little bit after they were born and then I decided I was going to stop. That's when I stopped. And my mother kept them for me while I was gone. But I stopped because it was just too much and I wanted to be with my children myself. So I stopped all together.
